cr_data.provenance:
1926 until about early May 1967: The artist, Abiquiu, New Mexico 
Early May 1967 – 2018: Eugene (1899–1973) and Margaret (Milam) McDermott (1912-2018), Dallas, TX. [1] 
2018: By bequest to The Eugene and Margaret McDermott Art Fund, Inc., 2018. 
 
Note: 
[1] Painting Purchased as a pair from the artist in in early May 1967 in Abiquiu, New Mexico, with the assistance of Doris Bry (1920–2014), New York 
(Source: Dallas Museum of Art, 2025)

credit_line: Dallas Museum of Art, The Eugene and Margaret McDermott Art Fund, Inc., bequest of Mrs. Eugene McDermott
description: An enlarged white clamshell, seen on its side, stretches from the bottom to the top of this narrow composition. The shell is closed, and its rippling form is almost entirely white save for a few small patches of yellow. The shell sits against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Dallas Museum of Art.
title: Closed Clam Shell
